title: 새우 넣고 투움바 라면 Toowoomba Ramen
description:
#투움바라면 #Toowoomba Ramen

투움바 라면

[재료]
*라면 1개
*양파 1/4개
*마늘 5개
*냉동새우 50g
*우유 200ml
*체다치즈 1장
*소금
*식용유

[만드는 법]
1. 마늘과 양파를 얇게 썰어요.
2. 식용유를 두른 팬에 마늘을 볶다가 약간 익으면 양파를 넣고 같이 볶아요.
3. 양파가 살짝 익으면 냉동 새우를 넣고 살짝 볶은 뒤 우유 200ml 넣고 약한불로 데워요.
4. 다른 냄비에 물 3컵과 소금 한 꼬집을 넣고 끓여요.  물이 끓으면 라면을 넣고 끓여요. 
5. 90초가 지나면 면발을 건져서 소스를 만든 팬에 넣고 90초 정도 약불로 졸여요.  
6. 면발이 다 익으면 그릇에 담아 맛있게 먹어요.  

[Ingredients]
*1 ramen
*1/4 onion
*five cloves of garlic
*frozen shrimp 50g
*200ml milk
*one slice cheddar cheese
*salt
*cooking oil

[How to make it]
1. Slice 5 cloves of garlic and 1/4 onions thinly.
2. Stir-fry garlic in a pan with cooking oil.  When garlics are slightly cooked, put onions in the pan and stir-fry together.
3. When onions are cooked, add shrimp and stir fry.  
4. Add 200 of milk and boil it on a low heat.
5. Prepare another pot with 3 cups of water with a pinch of salt and bring to a boil.  Put ramen noodles into the pot and boil them for 90 seconds and then take the noodles out.  
*Ramen noodles shouldn’t be fully cooked at this point.  
6. Put the ramen noodles into the sauce pan and boil it down for about 90 seconds.  
7. When the noodles are cooked put them in a bowl and enjoy your meal.
